text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Multiple deploy pipelines failing due to GitHub Actions / GitHub Packages errors (package publish 502s, runners time out). Detected 4 failing deploy jobs in the last 3 minutes. Severity: P2 — potential customer impact on hotfix rollouts. Paging oncall-elaine.

oncall-elaine: got it, I'm on. seeing failures when trying to publish the hotfix package to ghcr.io and npm.pkg.github.com: 502 / connection reset during upload. Re-ran a workflow and it failed quickly.

sre-aaron: I can jump in. are builds failing to start or failing at publish step? any logs?

oncall-elaine: builds run fine up to packaging step. publish step (actions/upload-artifact and publishing to GitHub Packages) returns 502. Logs: "remote server returned an error: (502) Bad Gateway". Also a few GH Actions runners show long queue times, then timeouts.

eng-ops-raj: looks like upstream GitHub issue. status.github.com shows partial degradation for Actions and Packages in region us-east-1. Link: https://www.githubstatus.com/ (posted)

pm-julia: we have a hotfix queued for PG-1234 that needs to go out to 3 enterprise customers. Without the hotfix we have a regression on inference latency for a small subset of requests. What is customer impact?

support-lara: customers affected: acme-inc (SLA customer), beta-team, and a few self-serve. Acme reported increased 500s on their inference endpoints starting ~10m ago. They need the fix asap. I've opened a support DM.

oncall-elaine: quick assessment: build artifact exists on the runner for two jobs (artifact uploaded locally), but upload to GH artifact storage fails. We can salvage artifacts from the ephemeral runner workspace and push to an alternative registry if we can get a manual consumer path. Options: 1) push artifacts to S3 + signed URL and manual deploy; 2) push docker image to Docker Hub / ECR if auth works; 3) use a private mirror (Artifactory) if available; 4) wait for GitHub to resolve.

sre-aaron: for speed, try building the container locally on a self-hosted runner and push to ECR (we have durable creds). That will bypass GH Packages. eng-ops-raj, can we spin a temporary self-hosted runner?

eng-ops-raj: spinning up a t3 runner now. attaching to repo with label 'temp-hotfix-runner'. Will share SSH once ready.

oncall-elaine: while that's provisioning, I'll scp the workspace tar from the failing ephemeral runner (deploy-bot shows path) and try to re-build image locally. Command plan:
```
# on ephemeral runner host
tar -czf /tmp/workspace.tar.gz /home/runner/work/repo
scp /tmp/workspace.tar.gz ec2-user@temp-runner:/tmp/
ssh ec2-user@temp-runner 'cd /tmp && tar -xzf workspace.tar.gz && cd repo && ./scripts/build_image.sh && docker tag myapp:hotfix 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/myapp:hotfix && docker push ...'
```

support-lara: I'll let Acme know we're attempting a manual workaround and will update timeline to +90m for recovery, unless we can cut a hotfix faster.

pm-julia: also consider that our CI gating uses package manifests referencing GitHub Packages. If we push to ECR, we need to patch deployment manifests to point at ECR image and run a manual canary deploy. Keep change minimal.

sre-aaron: agreed. target manual canary deploy to one pod in staging first, then to production if green. I'll prepare a rollback command.

eng-ops-raj: runner is up and reachable. sharing SSH in DM.

oncall-elaine: copying workspace over now. seeing build warnings but image built. pushing to ECR — auth succeeded. push started, awaiting completion.

incident-bot: NOTE: Created incident ticket INC-2026 in PagerDuty and Opsgenie, assigned to oncall-elaine.

sre-aaron: once ECR image is available, I'll patch deployment using kubectl set image and target the canary autoscaler. Command: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/redwood-app redwood-app=123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/myapp:hotfix --record` then scale to 1 replica for canary.

oncall-elaine: push complete. tag present in ECR. initiating canary now.

support-lara: Pinged Acme with ETA ~45m, noted workaround path and that we're performing manual deploy. Customer asked for an incident bridge — they want to join if this escalates.

pm-julia: important: CI-generated release notes are attached to the GH workflow that failed. We should capture the commit hash and include it in the manual deployment notes. commit: a1b2c3d4.

sre-aaron: canary pod is up, smoke tests passing (latency back within expected range). running additional e2e checks.

oncall-elaine: e2e green on canary. Initiating gradual rollout to remaining pods.

incident-bot: UPDATE: GitHub status indicates ongoing partial outage for Actions / Packages. No ETA from vendor. Link posted.

support-lara: Acme responded: they see traffic normalized on their instance. Thanked us and asked for postmortem.

pm-julia: decision log: we will continue with manual image push to ECR and manual deploy process until GitHub Packages fully recovers. We'll record the patch steps, update runbook, and notify customers of the mitigation. Also open a ticket with GitHub support referencing deploy job IDs and timestamps.

sre-aaron: created GH ticket: https://github.com/contact/support?issue=SUP-992 (internal ref). Uploaded logs and failing workflow run URL.

oncall-elaine: handoff: I need to go offline for 30m. Passing oncall to sre-aaron. Key notes for next oncall: artifacts present on ECR under tag 'hotfix-1786009876', canary passed, manual rollout in progress; GitHub outage ongoing — do not trigger new GH Packages publishes; prefer ECR or S3 for emergency publishes.

sre-aaron: ack, taking over. will keep monitoring and coordinate updates to status page + postmortem.

eng-ops-raj: quick ops note: let's add a pre-built-artifact policy to runbook to reduce this friction next time (maintain signed artifacts in S3 on successful CI run before publish). Filing follow-up ticket DOCS-44.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Manual mitigation succeeded, customer impact mitigated. Severity downgraded to P3. Please file postmortem and remediation items.

pm-julia: filing postmortem with timeline and action items. will include action item to add alternate registry fallback and to automate artifact archival.

support-lara: closing customer communications loop. will follow up with Acme to offer technical debrief.

sre-aaron: final note: we should also review deploy-bot's behavior when publish fails — it retried aggressively and exhausted ephemeral runner quota. Action: add smarter retry/backoff and preserve workspace on failures. Filing SRE-ops-12.

eng-ops-raj: thanks everyone.

oncall-elaine: back online, thanks for the handoff.

support-lara: marking incident: resolved (no ongoing customer impact). will attach summary to ticket INC-2026.

incident-bot: Thread closed after resolution update."
